arXiv:2608.20274v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 8 月 20 日arXiv:2608.20274v1 [cs.AI] 20 Aug 2026

分解，传承：LLM 代理的跨任务技能转移Break It Down, Pass It On: Cross-Task Skill Transfer in LLM Agents

Yiyang Feng    Biddut Sarker Bijoy    Niranjan Balasubramanian    Jiawei Zhou Affiliation: Computer Science Department, Stony Brook University, Stony Brook, USA Affiliation: {yiyfeng, bbijoy, niranjan, jiawei.zhou.1}@cs.stonybrook.edu
摘要Abstract

大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理可以从已完成的任务中归纳技能，并在以后重复使用它们，以通过经验提高能力。在实践中，诱导技能可能会不可靠地转移，甚至可能损害检索它们的代理。智能体引发的技能何时能可靠地跨任务传递仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。我们对技能的诱导方式如何影响其跨任务的转移进行了全面的、受控的研究。 具体来说， 我们将任务级别与子任务级别的技能归纳以及文本与代码技能格式进行比较，这是现有方法不同的两个轴。 任务级技能主要降低代理的绩效 低于其无记忆基线，而子任务级技能则使其高于平均水平，并且文本技能的迁移优于代码技能。 为了进一步了解我们的发现，我们检查了诱导技能的两个互补特性：Large language model (LLM) agents can induce skills from completed tasks and reuse them later to grow more capable with experience. In practice, induced skills may transfer unreliably and can even harm the agent that retrieves them. When agent-induced skills transfer reliably across tasks remains an open question. We conduct a comprehensive and controlled study of how the way skills are induced shapes their transfer across tasks. Specifically, we compare task-level with subtask-level skill induction and text with code skill formats, the two axes along which existing methods differ. Task-level skills mostly reduce the agent’s performance below its no-memory baseline while subtask-level skills raise it above on average, and text skills transfer better than code skills. To further understand our findings, we examine two complementary properties of the induced skills:特异性specificity, 它衡量技能与实际任务的匹配程度，以及, which measures how closely a skill matches real tasks, and抽象性abstractness，它衡量其相关性在任务之间分布的均匀程度。这两个属性都不能单独预测任务的成功，但它们的综合效应可以预测任务的成功，我们建议将其作为, which measures how evenly its relevance spreads across tasks. Neither property alone predicts task success, but their combined effect does, which we propose as a技能效用skill utility得分。 当技能转移时，分数与任务成功相关，并且子任务级别和文本技能得分更高。计算技能实用程序只需要技能和任务描述，而不需要任何任务执行，因此我们的分数可以在任何新任务运行之前作为技能记忆的实用诊断。score. The score correlates consistently with task success when skills are transferred, and subtask-level and text skills score higher. Computing skill utility only needs the skills and task descriptions but not any task execution, so our score serves as a practical diagnostic of a skill memory before any new task runs.11 1代码和数据可在Code and data are available athttps://github.com/Zesearch/skill-transfer-llm-agents.

1 简介Introduction

尽管大型语言模型（LLM）代理在个人协助、办公自动化和科学研究等工作流程中得到广泛使用Despite the wide use of large language model (LLM) agents in workflows such as personal assistance, office automation, and scientific researchTrivedi et al. 2024; Wang et al. 2024c; Lai et al. 2026，这些代理以幼稚的形式从头开始解决每项任务，并且不会随着经验而变得更好。越来越多的工作使代理能够从已完成的任务中归纳出技能，将它们存储在技能记忆中，并为以后的任务检索它们, these agents in their naive form solve each task from scratch and do not get better with experience. A growing line of work enables agents to induce skills from completed tasks, store them in a skill memory, and retrieve them for later tasks(Wang et al. 2024a; Zhao et al. 2024; Wang et al. 2025c; Wang et al. 2025b)。如果诱发的技能可以跨任务转移，那么代理的能力会随着时间的推移而变得越来越强。. If the induced skills transfer across tasks, an agent becomes increasingly capable over time.

然而，在实践中，当技能是从已完成任务的整个轨迹中归纳出来时，技能转移是不可靠的。首先，从整个轨迹导出的技能与其源任务相关联（图 1）。In practice, however, skill transfer is unreliable when skills are induced from the whole trajectories of completed tasks. First, a skill induced from a whole trajectory is tied to its source task (Fig.1）并且对新任务的泛化能力较差) and generalizes poorly to new tasks(Yu et al. 2025; Fang et al. 2026)。其次，这些过于专业的技能作为不相关或错位的上下文进入后续任务，这会分散模型的注意力并从源任务传播错误. Second, these over-specialized skills enter later tasks as irrelevant or misaligned context, which distracts the model and propagates errors from the source task(Shi et al. 2023; Yoran et al. 2024; Xiong et al. 2026)。因此，技能转移是否有帮助取决于技能是如何诱导的，这提出了我们的核心问题：. Therefore, whether skill transfer helps depends on how skills are induced, raising our central question:代理引发的技能何时能够可靠地跨任务转移？when do agent-induced skills transfer reliably across tasks?

最近的一项工作表明在子任务级别诱导技能A recent line of work suggests inducing skills at the subtask level(Nottingham et al. 2024; Yang et al. 2026; Shen et al. 2026)。鉴于任务通常共享子过程，智能体可以从每个分解的子任务而不是整个轨迹中归纳出一项技能（图 1）。. Given that tasks often share sub-procedures, agents could induce one skill from each decomposed subtask rather than from the whole trajectory (Fig.1），并且早期结果报告了更好的性能。然而，这种进步的证据仍然很狭窄，只涵盖有限的领域、很少的模型和文本技能。 因此回答我们的核心问题 需要进行分析，在不同技能格式、领域和模型的相同条件下比较任务级和子任务级归纳。), and early results report better performance. Yet the evidence for this gain stays narrow, covering limited domains, few models, and text skills only. Answering our central question therefore requires an analysis that compares task-level with subtask-level induction under identical conditions across various skill formats, domains, and models.

我们对代理应如何诱导可靠的跨任务转移技能进行全面且受控的分析。 我们的分析改变了两个控制：技能归纳级别（技能是总结整个轨迹还是单个子任务）以及技能格式（技能是存储为文本还是代码）。 我们的实验涵盖三个长期基准和 11 个开放权重和专有模型。技能归纳等级决定技能是否有帮助。子任务级技能平均将智能体提升到无记忆基线以上，而任务级技能往往会损害同一智能体。然后，技能格式决定了技能有多少帮助或伤害，因为在两个技能归纳级别上，文本技能比代码技能转移得更好（第二节）。We conduct a comprehensive and controlled analysis of how agents should induce skills for reliable cross-task transfer. Our analysis varies two controls, the skill induction level, whether a skill summarizes a whole trajectory or a single subtask, and the skill format, whether a skill is stored as text or as code. Our experiments cover three long-horizon benchmarks and 11 open-weight and proprietary models. The skill induction level decides whether skills help. Subtask-level skills lift the agent above the no-memory baseline on average, while task-level skills tend to harm the same agent. The skill format then decides how much skills help or hurt, as text skills transfer better than code skills at both skill induction levels (Sec.5).

为了进一步了解这些发现， 我们检查诱导技能的两个互补属性：To further understand these findings, we examine two complementary properties of the induced skills:特异性specificity，衡量技能与实际任务的匹配程度，以及, which measures how closely a skill matches real tasks, and抽象性abstractness，它衡量其相关性在任务之间分布的均匀程度。我们表明，这两种属性都不能单独预测任务的成功，但它们的产品却可以。我们将该产品定义为, which measures how evenly its relevance spreads across tasks. We show that neither property alone predicts task success, but their product does. We define this product as a技能效用skill utility得分。与我们的发现一致，子任务级别和文本技能具有更高的技能实用性（第 2 节）。score. Consistent with our findings, subtask-level and text skills have higher skill utility (Sec.6).

我们的分析回答了开头的问题，为从业者提供了三个要点。首先，将任务分解为子任务并为每个子任务引入一项技能可以改善跨任务技能转移。其次，在这两个级别上，文本技能的传授都比代码技能更好。最后，技能实用程序充当轻量级诊断工具，因此从业者可以在任何新任务运行之前评估技能记忆。Our analysis answers the opening question with three takeaways for practitioners. First, decomposing a task into subtasks and inducing one skill per subtask improves cross-task skill transfer. Second, text skills transfer better than code skills at both levels. Finally, skill utility serves as a lightweight diagnostic tool, so a practitioner can assess a skill memory before any new task runs.

2 相关工作Related Work

代理技能Skills in agents。 一系列工作将座席的经验整合为明确的技能记忆. A line of work consolidates an agent’s experience into an explicit skill memory(Sharma et al. 2022; Park et al. 2023)，沿三个轴不同（表 1）, differing along three axes (Tab.1): (i) 技能入门水平，包括轨迹) the skill induction level, including a trajectory(Wang et al. 2024a; Zhao et al. 2024; Shinn et al. 2023; Majumder et al. 2024; Wang et al. 2025c), 一步, a step(Nguyen et al. 2025; Wang et al. 2026), 一条规则, a rule(Chen et al. 2024; Fu et al. 2024)，或子任务, or a subtask(Nottingham et al. 2024; Yang et al. 2026; Shen et al. 2026); (ii) 技能格式，包括文本) the skill format, including text(Zhao et al. 2024; Zhu et al. 2023; Majumder et al. 2024; Fang et al. 2026)或代码or code(Wang et al. 2024b; Wang et al. 2025b; Ellis et al. 2021; Grand et al. 2024; Cai et al. 2024; Qian et al. 2023; Yuan et al. 2024);和（; and (三、iii）归纳提示，带有各种说明、演示和抽象规则) the induction prompt, with various instructions, demonstrations, and abstraction rules(Hu et al. 2026)。 其他人则使用强化学习来训练记忆操作或技能增强策略. Others train memory operations or skill-augmented policies with RL(Yan et al. 2026; Xia et al. 2026; Feng et al. 2026a; Li et al. 2026)或无需诱导即可检索剧集or retrieve episodes without induction(Zheng et al. 2024; Zhang et al. 2026; Ahmed et al. 2026; Yang et al. 2024)。 我们在一个共享提示下改变级别和格式，隔离每个轴。. We vary the level and the format under one shared prompt, isolating each axis.

跨任务技能转移Cross-Task Skill Transfer。 现有的任务级技能转移显示出跨多个领域的收益，涵盖网络. Existing task-level skill transfer shows gains across multiple domains, covering the web(Wang et al. 2025c; Wang et al. 2025b; Zheng et al. 2025; Zhou et al. 2025b),图形化界面控制, GUI control(Wang et al. 2025a), 体现的世界, embodied worlds(Sarch et al. 2024)、软件, software(Ouyang et al. 2026)或研究代理人or research agents(Zhou et al. 2025a)。 尽管任务级技能的研究范围很广，但子任务级技能迁移的研究仍然有限。 （. Despite the breadth of work on task-level skills, the study of subtask-level skill transfer stays limited. (i）每项工作都在有限的领域评估其技能) Each work evaluates its skills on limited domains(Nottingham et al. 2024; Yang et al. 2026; Shen et al. 2026). (ii）尽管使用了包括重用计数或库增长在内的统计数据，但端到端分数隐藏了每种技能对成功的贡献) End-to-end scores hide each skill’s contribution to success despite using statistics including reuse counts or library growth(Zhong et al. 2026; Tan et al. 2025; Fang et al. 2026; Yu et al. 2025). (三、iii）大多数工作明确表明技能会带来收益，但其他工作则意味着相反，因为不相关的上下文会降低模型的性能) Most work shows explicitly that skills bring gains, but other work implies the opposite, as irrelevant context degrades models(Shi et al. 2023; Yoran et al. 2024; Cuconasu et al. 2024; Liu et al. 2024)，未对准的记忆会传播错误, misaligned memories propagate errors(Xiong et al. 2026; Feng et al. 2025)，甚至相关记忆也可能无法传播, and even relevant memories can fail to propagate(Zhong et al. 2023; Feng et al. 2026b)。 因此，我们研究技能转移何时有益或有害，隔离每个选择并验证每项技能的效用分数是否成功。. We therefore study when skill transfer helps or hurts, isolating each choice and validating a per-skill utility score against success.

长视野智能体中的子任务分解Subtask decomposition in long-horizon agents。 先前的工作将复杂的问题分解为更容易解决的原子子问题. Prior work breaks a complex question into atomic sub-questions that are easier to solve(Zhou et al. 2023; Khot et al. 2023; Dua et al. 2022; Prasad et al. 2024; Sun et al. 2023)。长视野代理采用相同的想法来保持增长上下文简短并处理长视野任务中的每个子任务. Long-horizon agents adopt the same idea to keep the growing context short and tackle each subtask in long-horizon tasks(Hu et al. 2025; Ye et al. 2026; Sun et al. 2026)。然而，子任务边界仅服务于当前任务，并且没有跨任务的技能转移。有些作品跨任务转移子任务技能，但仅限于一两个领域和很少的模型. However, the subtask boundary serves only the current task, and no skill transfers across tasks. Some works transfer subtask skills across tasks, but they are limited to one or two domains and few models(Nottingham et al. 2024; Yang et al. 2026; Shen et al. 2026)。相反，我们研究两个入门级别的跨任务技能转移，跨两种技能格式、三个领域和十一个模型。. We instead study cross-task skill transfer at both induction levels, across two skill formats, three domains, and eleven models.

3 跨任务技能转移Cross-Task Skill Transfer

本节形式化了跨任务技能转移，其中 LLM 代理解决一系列任务，其在早期任务上的经验会影响其解决后续任务的方式。我们引入了两个映射到两个技能入门级别的代理（第 2 节）。This section formalizes cross-task skill transfer, where an LLM agent solves a stream of tasks and its experience on earlier tasks affects how it solves later ones. We introduce two agents that map to two skill induction levels (Sec.3.1），一种以两种不同格式诱导、存储和检索技能的技能记忆（第 2 节）。), a skill memory that induces, stores, and retrieves skills in two different formats (Sec.3.2），以及跨任务技能转移的定义（第 2 节）。), and a definition of cross-task skill transfer (Sec.3.3）。图。). Fig.2显示插图，完整提示在 App 中。shows the illustration, and the full prompts are in App.A.

3.1 代理商Agents

代理在部分可观察的环境中解决每个任务An agent solves each task in a partially observable environment(Kaelbling et al. 1998)。任务指定自然语言目标和初始环境状态。在步骤. A task specifies a natural-language goal and an initial environment state. At steptt, 法学硕士政策, an LLM policyπ\pi产生一个动作generates an actionata_{t}基于到目前为止的交互，环境返回一个观察结果based on the interaction so far, and the environment returns an observationoto_{t}。当代理发出完成信号或达到步数限制时，评估者会给予最终状态奖励. When the agent signals completion or reaches a step limit, an evaluator gives the final state a rewardr∈[0,1]r\in[0,1].

任务级代理Task-level agent。 任务级代理是一个扁平的 ReAct 循环. The task-level agent is a flat ReAct loop(Yao et al. 2023)。它附加 (. It appends (⊕\oplus）每一个动作和观察都集中在一个上下文中) every action and observation into one contextht=ht−1⊕(at,ot)h_{t}=h_{t-1}\oplus(a_{t},o_{t})从最初的提示开始that grows from an initial prompth0h_{0}对目标进行编码，并绘制每个动作encoding the goal, and draws each actionata_{t}来自fromπ(⋅∣ht−1)\pi(\cdot\mid h_{t-1})。循环在整个任务轨迹中结束. The loop ends in the whole-task trajectoryτ=h0⊕(a1,o1)⊕⋯⊕(aT,oT)\tau=h_{0}\oplus(a_{1},o_{1})\oplus\dots\oplus(a_{T},o_{T}).

子任务级代理Subtask-level agent。 子任务级代理运行相同的环境和策略，但它将每个任务分解为子任务. The subtask-level agent runs the same environment and policy, but it decomposes each task into subtasks(Zhou et al. 2023; Prasad et al. 2024)三个角色的循环。计划者读取目标和运行摘要，然后提出下一个子任务或宣布任务完成。执行器在当前子任务上运行 ReAct 循环，生成子轨迹with a cycle of three roles. A planner reads the goal and the running summary, then proposes the next subtask or declares the task complete. An executor runs a ReAct loop on the current subtask, producing a sub-trajectoryτk\tau_{k}对于子任务for subtaskkk。然后摘要器进行压缩. A summarizer then compressesτk\tau_{k}进入下一个周期的运行总结into the running summary for the next cycle(Hu et al. 2025)。重复该循环，直到规划器声明完成或达到子任务限制，以任务轨迹结束. The cycle repeats until the planner declares completion or a subtask limit is reached, ending in the task trajectoryτ=(τ1,…,τK)\tau=(\tau_{1},\dots,\tau_{K})。因此，任务级代理是子任务级代理的特例，其中整个任务形成单个子任务，并且只有执行器运行。. The task-level agent is thus a special case of the subtask-level agent, where the whole task forms the single subtask and only the executor runs.

3.2 技能记忆Skill Memory

技能记忆A skill memoryMM存储代理经验中的技能，以便在以后的任务中重复使用。归纳算子将已完成的任务或子任务的轨迹转化为技能，检索算子从中读取相关技能stores skills from the agent’s experience for reuse on later tasks. An induction operator turns the trajectory of a completed task or subtask into a skill, and a retrieval operator reads relevant skills fromMM在任务或子任务之前。before a task or subtask.

技能格式Skill format。 每个技能都有一个简短的自然语言描述（也用于检索），以及一个以文本或代码格式承载主要内容的主体，其灵感来自. Each skill has a short natural-language description (also used for retrieval), and a body that carries the main content in text or code format inspired byWang et al. 2025c; Wang et al. 2025b。文本技能将正文编写为工作流程注释，列出过程及其特定于环境的警告。代码技能将主体编写为 Python 函数，其中特定于实例的值作为参数，环境警告作为代码注释。. A text skill writes the body as a workflow note, listing the procedure and its environment-specific caveats. A code skill writes the body as a Python function with instance-specific values as parameters and environmental caveats as code comments.

技能归纳Skill induction。 技能是在两个层面上诱导的。任务级归纳转动已完成的任务轨迹. Skills are induced at two levels. Task-level induction turns the completed task trajectoryτ\tau转化为一项技能，子任务级归纳将每个已完成的子轨迹into one skill, and subtask-level induction turns each completed sub-trajectoryτk\tau_{k}融入一项技能。 这种每个轨迹一个技能的规则可以防止任务级别归纳将轨迹分割为多个类似子任务的技能，这会模糊两个级别。 两个级别共享相同的感应提示，因此对比仅隔离技能感应级别。 示例在应用程序中。into one skill. This one-skill-per-trajectory rule prevents task-level induction from splitting a trajectory into several subtask-like skills, which would blur the two levels. The two levels share the same induction prompt, so the contrast isolates only the skill induction level. Examples are in App.C.

技能检索Skill retrieval。 检索运算符. The retrieval operatorR⁡(M,q)R(M,q)嵌入技能描述和查询embeds skill descriptions and the queryqq带有嵌入模型with an embedding model22 2我们使用We use全MiniLM-L6-v2all-MiniLM-L6-v2, https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2.并将最热门的匹配注入到代理的上下文中。通过仅匹配描述以相同的方式检索文本和代码技能。任务级代理使用任务指令查询一次，子任务级代理在每个子任务上使用任务指令或子任务文本查询。每个检索到的技能都会输入上下文作为其描述和正文，并且代码技能也会加载到命名空间中，以便代理可以按名称调用它。内存还会修剪无法加载的代码技能，并合并或删除接近重复的描述（App.and injects the top matches into the agent’s context. Text and code skills are retrieved in the same way by matching the description only. The task-level agent queries once with the task instruction, and the subtask-level agent queries at each subtask with the task instruction or the subtask text. Every retrieved skill enters the context as its description and body, and a code skill is also loaded into the namespace so the agent can call it by name. The memory also prunes code skills that fail to load and merges or drops near-duplicate descriptions (App.B）。 我们在App中验证。). We verify in App.E.6技能条件的差异来自于技能本身，而不是检索质量。that the differences among skill conditions come from the skills themselves rather than from retrieval quality.

3.3 跨任务技能转移Cross-Task Skill Transfer

Sec 的特工。An agent from Sec.3.1解决一系列任务solves a stream of tasksT1,…,TnT_{1},\dots,T_{n}针对 Sec 的共享内存。against the shared memory of Sec.3.2。它在每个任务或子任务之后写入一项技能，并在每个任务或子任务之前读取它们，因此可以在后面的任务中检索在较早任务中引入的技能。我们称这种技能重用. It writes one skill after each task or subtask and reads them before each, so a skill induced on an earlier task can be retrieved on a later one. We call such skill reuse跨任务技能转移cross-task skill transfer.

设计选择Design choices。 我们的研究有两种选择。 （. Our study varies two choices. (i）技能归纳级别是从任务轨迹中归纳出每个技能的跨度，对于任务级智能体来说是整个任务，对于子任务级智能体来说是单个子任务。 （) The skill induction level is the span of task trajectory that each skill is induced from, the whole task for the task-level agent or a single subtask for the subtask-level agent. (ii) 技能格式是技能的存储方式，可以是文本注释、代码功能，也可以在内存关闭时无。 请注意，这两个代理仅在技能归纳级别以及子任务级别代理添加的计划器和摘要器提示方面有所不同。提示、记忆和检索的所有其他方面都是相同的。 剩余的差异在我们的比较中被抵消，因为每个具有技能的智能体都是与没有技能的同一智能体进行测量的，因此结果反映了每个级别诱导的技能的效果，而不是智能体本身。) The skill format is how a skill is stored, either a text note, a code function, or none when the memory is off. Note that the two agents differ only in the skill induction level, plus the subtask-level agent’s added planner and summarizer prompts. Every other aspect of the prompts, memory, and retrieval is identical. The remaining difference cancels in our comparisons, as each agent with skills is measured against the same agent without skills, so the results reflect the effect of the skills induced at each level rather than the agents themselves.

4 实验设置Experiment Setup

基准测试Benchmarks。 我们使用三个跨越不同领域的长期基准。. We use three long-horizon benchmarks that span diverse domains.应用世界AppWorld (Trivedi et al. 2024)涵盖了 Python REPL 中的多应用程序工具在九个具有记录的 API 的模拟应用程序中的使用。covers multi-app tool use in a Python REPL over nine simulated apps with documented APIs.办公室长凳OfficeBench (Wang et al. 2024c)涵盖电子邮件、Word、Excel 和 PDF 等应用程序上的办公文档工作流程。covers office-document workflows over apps such as Email, Word, Excel, and PDF.克拉玛长凳KramaBench (Lai et al. 2026)涵盖来自六个科学领域的真实文件的数据科学管道。我们对 AppWorld 测试挑战拆分（417 个任务）、300 个 OfficeBench 任务和 92 个确定性分级的 KramaBench 任务进行评估，每个任务的得分为covers data-science pipelines over real files from six scientific domains. We evaluate on the AppWorld test-challenge split (417 tasks), 300 OfficeBench tasks, and the 92 deterministically graded KramaBench tasks, each scored in[0,1][0,1]由其基准测试的官方评估员评估。by its benchmark’s official evaluator.

6 技能何时转移？When Do Skills Transfer?

要了解某些技能何时比其他技能转移得更好， 我们将注意力从代理人转向他们诱导的技能。我们定义了每项技能To understand when certain skills transfer better than others, we turn our focus from the agents to the skills they induce. We define a per-skill效用分数utility score仅根据诱导技能和任务描述计算（第 2 节）computed from the induced skills and the task descriptions alone (Sec.6.1），表明它解释了为什么子任务级别和文本技能迁移得更好（第 2 节）。), show that it explains why subtask-level and text skills transfer better (Sec.6.2），并检查它是否与任务流期间观察到的重用一致（第 2 节）。), and check that it agrees with the reuse observed during the task stream (Sec.6.3).

6.1 技能效用分数A Score for Skill Utility

现有文献假设技能的特殊性和普遍性之间存在紧张关系Existing literature hypothesizes a tension between a skill’s specificity and its generalizability(Yu et al. 2025; Fang et al. 2026)。我们建议可重用的技能必须满足两个要求：特异性和抽象性。特异性要求技能与实际任务足够相关，而抽象性要求技能与许多任务而不是少数任务保持相关性。假设. We suggest that a reusable skill must meet two requirements, specificity and abstractness. Specificity asks the skill to be relevant enough to real tasks, and abstractness asks the skill to stay relevant to many tasks rather than a few. Supposecjc_{j}表示技能之间的余弦相似度denotes the cosine similarity between a skillss和and thejj的第th of theNN检索嵌入器下的任务指令。task instructions under the retrieval embedder.

特异性Specificity衡量一项技能与其最相似的任务的接近程度。正在关注measures how close a skill is to the tasks it most resembles. FollowingEthayarajh 2019，我们将技能的最近任务相似度与任务之间的相似度进行比较，, we compare the skill’s nearest-task similarity with the similarities between tasks,

specificity(s)=Pr[maxjcj≥cos(ti,tk)],\mathrm{specificity}(s)=\Pr\big[\max_{j}c_{j}\geq\cos(t_{i},t_{k})\big],

使用技能比两个随机任务更接近其最近任务的概率using the probability that the skill is closer to its nearest task than two random taskstit_{i}和andtkt_{k}的基准是相互的。特异性会惩罚远离每项任务的不相关技能，其得分接近于零，并奖励与至少一项任务匹配的技能，其得分接近1。of the benchmark are to each other. Specificity punishes an irrelevant skill far from every task, which scores near zero, and rewards a skill matching at least one task, which scores near one.

抽象性Abstractness衡量一项技能的相关性如何均匀地分布在许多任务集上，而不是集中在少数任务上。我们把相似度measures how evenly a skill’s relevance spreads over many tasks set rather than concentrating on a few tasks. We turn the similaritycc进入分布并计算任务计数的困惑度以表示相关任务与技能的比率into a distribution and compute the perplexity over the task count to represent the ratio of relevant tasks to a skill(van der Maaten and Hinton 2008),

abstractness⁡(s)=exp⁡H⁡(softmax⁡(c/τ))N,\mathrm{abstractness}(s)=\frac{\exp H\big(\mathrm{softmax}(c/\tau)\big)}{N},

哪里wherec=(c1,…,cN)c=(c_{1},\dots,c_{N}), HH是熵，并且is the entropy, andτ=0.1\tau=0.1是一个温度。抽象性会惩罚与少数任务接近但与其他任务相去甚远的技能，该技能得分接近is a temperature. Abstractness punishes a skill that is close to a few tasks but far from the rest, which scores near1/N1/N，并奖励一项在许多任务中保持相关性的技能，得分接近于 1。, and rewards a skill that stays relevant across many tasks, which scores near one.

技能效用Skill utility。我们如图所示. We show in Fig.27这种特殊性和抽象性会影响任务级和子任务级技能。我们假设有用的技能可以很好地平衡这两个属性，因此我们将技能效用定义为这两个属性的乘积：that specificity and abstractness trade off for both task-level and subtask-level skills. We hypothesize that a useful skill balances the two properties well, so we define skill utility as the product of both properties:

utility⁡(s)=specificity⁡(s)⋅abstractness⁡(s).\mathrm{utility}(s)=\mathrm{specificity}(s)\cdot\mathrm{abstractness}(s).

6.2 技能效用预测任务成功收益Skill Utility Predicts Task Success Gains

我们检查技能效用是否解释了第二节的结果。We examine whether skill utility explains accounts for the results of Sec.5，该技能主要在子任务级归纳下有帮助，并且文本技能比代码技能转移得更好。, that skills help mostly under subtask-level induction and that text skills transfer better than code skills.

更高的效用，更多的成功Higher utility, more successes。如果高效用技能可以解释任务成功的收益，那么检索高效用技能的任务应该会更成功。我们根据智能体在解决任务时检索到的技能的平均效用对每个任务进行评分，根据任务级和子任务级智能体的分数对任务进行排名，并将每个排名分成相等大小的箱。成功在各个垃圾箱中单调上升，从. If high-utility skills explain the task success gains, tasks that retrieve higher-utility skills should succeed more. We score each task by the average utility of the skills the agent retrieves when solving the task, rank tasks by the score for task-level and subtask-level agents, and split each ranking into equal-size bins. Success rises monotonically across the bins, from14.0%14.0\% to 24.5%24.5\%对于任务级代理和来自for the task-level agent and from22.8%22.8\% to 31.0%31.0\%对于子任务级代理（图 1）for the subtask-level agent (Fig.5a). 除了技能效用和任务成功之间的相关性之外，我们还分析了技能效用的因果效应。 首先，即使成功率急剧下降，检索技能效用在每个基准的本机难度级别上几乎保持不变，并且效用不断在固定难度级别内预测成功。 我们还按照其中间效用分割相同的技能库，并在相同的任务上一次重新运行代理，并且每次使用一半，并且高效用的一半为任务级和子任务级库（App.1）带来更高的成功。a). Beyond the correlation between skill utility and task success, we also analyze the causal effect of skill utility. First, retrieved-skill utility stays nearly flat across each benchmark’s native difficulty levels even though success falls steeply, and utility keeps predicting success within a fixed difficulty level. We also split the same skill library at its median utility and rerun the agent on the same tasks with one half at a time, and the high-utility half yields higher success for both the task-level and the subtask-level library (App.E.4).

这两个维度本身都不能预测成功Neither dimension, by itself, predicts success。 单独的特异性和抽象性都不能预测子任务级智能体的成功。在图中。. Neither specificity nor abstractness alone predicts the success of the subtask-level agent. In Fig.5b、随着具体性或抽象性的增加，成功率先上升后下降。该现象源自图 1 中的权衡。b, success rises and then falls as specificity or abstractness increases. The phenomenon follows from the tradeoff in Fig.27，因为在一个维度上很高的技能放弃了另一个维度并失去了效用。因此，当两个维度保持平衡时，代理最成功，只有产品会奖励这一点。, as a skill high on one dimension gives up the other and loses utility. The agent therefore succeeds most when the two dimensions stay balanced, which only the product rewards.

子任务级别和文本技能具有更高的实用性Subtask-level and text skills have higher utility。 接下来我们比较两个入门级别和两种技能格式的技能效用。对于每种条件，我们采用诱导技能的中位效用（这对于一些异常值来说是稳健的），并在每个基准上对所有模型的中位进行平均。 从图.. We next compare the skill utility across the two induction levels and the two skill formats. For each condition we take the median utility of induced skills, which is robust to a few outliers, and average the medians over all models on each benchmark. From Fig.5从 c 到 e，几乎在所有基准和技能格式上，子任务级技能的得分都高于任务级技能，只有 KramaBench 上的文本并列。此外，在每个基准测试中，在两个入门级别中，文本技能的得分均高于代码技能。c to e, subtask-level skills score higher than task-level skills on almost every benchmark and skill format, with the only tie for text on KramaBench. Besides, text skills score higher than code at both induction levels on every benchmark.

6.3 技能实用程序与实际的跨任务重用相匹配Skill Utility Matches Actual Cross-Task Reuse

最后，我们检查技能效用是否反映了任务流期间实际发生的跨任务重用。Finally, we check whether skill utility reflects the cross-task reuse that actually happens during the task stream.

转移密度Transfer density。我们将每个基准测试的任务流划分为. We cut each benchmark’s task stream inton=50n=50按流顺序相等的 bin。传输密度是至少进行一次实际传输的有序 bin 对的份额，equal bins in stream order. Transfer density is the share of ordered bin pairs that carry at least one actual transfer,

D=1(n2)​∑i<jri​j,D=\frac{1}{\binom{n}{2}}\sum_{i<j}r_{ij},

哪里whereri​j=1r_{ij}=1当技能在bin中引发时when a skill induced in binii在稍后的垃圾箱中检索is retrieved in a later binjj, 和, and00否则。我们计算每个模型和技能格式的密度并报告它们的平均值。otherwise. We compute the density for each model and skill format and report the average over them.

结果Results。 在所有三个基准测试中，子任务级代理比任务级代理更密集地重用技能（图 1）。. The subtask-level agent reuses skills more densely than the task-level agent on all three benchmarks (Fig.6）。因此，实用性得分较高的技能归纳级别也是技能被更频繁重用的级别，因此分数与实际发生的迁移相匹配。每个单元格还显示技能在流中的何处被诱导和重用。). The skill induction level that scores higher utility is thus also the one whose skills are reused more often, so the score matches the transfer that actually happens. Each cell also shows where in the stream a skill was induced and reused.

7 结论Conclusion

我们研究诱导技能何时跨任务转移，在三个基准和十一个模型上比较不同的技能诱导水平和技能格式。我们表明，子任务级技能可以改善智能体，而任务级技能会损害它，并且文本技能比代码技能转移得更好。技能效用得分，平衡特异性和抽象性，与任务成功相关，将获胜条件排名更高，并在任何任务运行之前充当技能记忆的免执行诊断。We study when induced skills transfer across tasks, comparing different skill induction levels and skill formats on three benchmarks and eleven models. We show that subtask-level skills can improve the agent while task-level skills harm it, and text skills transfer better than code skills. Skill utility score, balancing specificity and abstractness, correlates with task success, ranks the winning conditions higher, and serves as an execution-free diagnostic of a skill memory before any task runs.

局限性Limitations

我们的研究根据三个标准基准来评估长期代理，这三个标准基准涵盖多应用工具使用、办公文档工作流程和数据科学管道，每个基准均由其官方评估员评分。这些选择为我们的结论提供了受控基础，将其扩展到此范围之外将需要三项额外的研究。 首先，其他代理设置，例如计算机使用Our study evaluates long-horizon agents on three standard benchmarks that together span multi-app tool use, office-document workflows, and data-science pipelines, each scored by its official evaluator. These choices give our conclusions a controlled basis, and extending them beyond this scope would need three additional studies. First, other agentic settings such as computer use(Xie et al. 2024), 代理编码, agentic coding(Deng et al. 2026; Merrill et al. 2026)，以及网络搜索, and web search(Wei et al. 2025)可能会表现出不同的转移行为，因此在那里复制我们的发现需要额外的实验。这些环境需要具有 root 访问权限的 Docker，而具有该级别安全访问权限的大规模计算很难获得。 其次，我们的技能记忆遵循固定的归纳、检索和重复数据删除规则，这使六个条件保持可比性，而最近的系统允许代理随着时间的推移修改其存储的技能和记忆may show different transfer behavior, so replicating our findings there requires additional experiments. Those environments require Docker with root access, and large-scale compute with that level of security access is difficult to obtain. Second, our skill memory follows fixed induction, retrieval, and deduplication rules, which keeps the six conditions comparable, while recent systems let the agent revise its stored skills and memory over time(Fang et al. 2026; Packer et al. 2024)。这样的修改需要沙箱文件系统，因此研究它也面临着上面提到的根 Docker 约束。将我们的发现扩展到这种不断进化的记忆需要一项单独的研究。 最后，我们根据每个任务的最终环境状态对其进行评分，这保持了评分的确定性和可比性。这些基准没有提供步骤级的基本事实，因此对中间决策的更细粒度的分析需要一个判断模型，我们将其留给未来的工作。. Such revision needs a sandboxed file system, so studying it also faces the root Docker constraint noted above. Extending our findings to such evolving memories requires a separate study. Finally, we score each task by its final environment state, which keeps grading deterministic and comparable. The benchmarks provide no step-level ground truth, so a finer-grained analysis of intermediate decisions would need a judge model, and we leave it to future work.

道德考虑Ethical Considerations

我们的工作探讨了法学硕士代理人何时能够可靠地重用从其过去的经验中得出的技能。跨任务传输过程的技能记忆也可能会传输有害的技能，因为将恶意技能注入库的对手可以通过相同的重用机制来引导代理。我们的实验不存在这样的风险，因为每项技能都是由代理本身从沙盒基准任务中诱导而来，没有真实的用户数据。我们认为可靠地重用可信技能是决定信任哪些存储技能这一更艰巨挑战的先决条件，因此检测和拒绝恶意技能留待未来的工作。Our work probes when an LLM agent can reliably reuse skills induced from its own past experience. A skill memory that transfers procedures across tasks could also transfer harmful ones, because an adversary who injects malicious skills into the library could steer the agent through the same reuse mechanism. Our experiments carry no such risk, since every skill is induced by the agent itself from sandboxed benchmark tasks without real user data. We regard reliable reuse of trustworthy skills as a prerequisite for the harder challenge of deciding which stored skills to trust, so detecting and rejecting malicious skills is left for future work.

附录AAppendix A提示Prompts

我们在三个基准测试中列出了两个代理的部署提示和两种技能格式。蓝色框保存系统消息，黄色框保存用户消息。大括号标记运行时填充的值，灰色钩标记软换行。 两个归纳级别共享技能归纳提示，而任务级代理是子任务级代理的一种特殊情况，因为它将整个任务作为唯一的一个子目标，因此归纳级别仅在归纳步骤读取的轨迹跨度上有所不同。We list the deployed prompts of the two agents and the two skill formats on the three benchmarks. Blue boxes hold system messages and yellow boxes hold user messages. Curly braces mark values filled at run time, and a gray hook marks a soft line wrap. The two induction levels share the skill induction prompt, and task-level agent is a special case of subtask-level agent because it has the whole task as the only one subgoal, so an induction level differs only in the trajectory span the induction step reads.

A.1 子任务级代理Subtask-Level Agent

子任务级代理运行计划器、执行器和摘要器，执行器是作用于环境的角色。执行器的系统提示符是图2的执行核心。The subtask-level agent runs a planner, an executor, and a summarizer, and the executor is the role that acts on the environment. The executor’s system prompt is the execution core of Figs.7, 8, 和, and9，然后是图 2 和 3 中的角色块。, followed by its role block in Figs.10, 11, 和, and12.

执行者的用户消息（图1）The executor’s user message (Fig.13) 包含当前子目标、上下文任务、进度摘要以及 OfficeBench 上的实时操作菜单。为子目标检索的技能输入以图 1 的格式框架封装的消息。) carries the current subgoal, the task for context, the progress summary, and on OfficeBench the live action menu. The skills retrieved for a subgoal enter this message wrapped in the format framing of Fig.14，因此执行器仅将记住的过程视为当前子目标的提示。, so the executor treats remembered procedures as hints for the current subgoal only.

规划器和摘要器重用相同的执行核心并附加自己的角色块。规划器在每次调用时都会重新构建，因此它只能看到任务和当前进度摘要。摘要器读取执行者对话并通过一个进度摘要工具调用进行回复。他们的用户留言也如图所示。The planner and the summarizer reuse the same execution core and append their own role blocks. The planner is rebuilt fresh at every call, so it sees only the task and the current progress summary. The summarizer reads the executor conversation and replies with one progress summary tool call. Their user messages are also in Fig.13.

A.2 任务级代理Task-Level Agent

任务级代理是作为特殊情况运行的执行器，其单个子目标是整个任务。规划器和摘要器块消失，并且它具有与子任务代理的执行器相同的系统和用户提示。唯一的区别是单个子目标是整个任务，而不是计划者产生的任务。 打开技能记忆后，检索到的技能将作为图 1 框架下的另一条用户消息输入。The task-level agent is the executor run as a special case whose single subgoal is the whole task. The planner and summarizer blocks drop away, and it has the same system and user prompts as the executor of the subtask agent. The only difference is that the single subgoal is the whole task instead of one produced by the planner. With skill memory on, the retrieved skills enter as one further user message under the framing of Fig.14。检索到的代码技能也会加载到执行命名空间中，以便代理可以按名称调用函数。. A retrieved code skill is also loaded into the execution namespace so the agent can call the function by name.

A.3 文本技能归纳Text-Skill Induction

在任务级别的任务之后，或者在子任务级别的每个子目标之后，图1和2的归纳提示。After a task at the task level, or after each subgoal at the subtask level, the induction prompt of Figs.15, 16, 或, or17作为用户消息附加到完成的跨度。该模型必须使用一个技能归纳工具调用来回答，该工具调用的参数包含描述和注释正文。is appended to the finished span as a user message. The model must answer with one skill induction tool call whose arguments hold the description and the note body.

A.4 代码技能归纳Code-Skill Induction

代码技能归纳遵循与图 1 和 2 的提示相同的协议。Code-skill induction follows the same protocol with the prompts of Figs.18, 19, 和, and20。该工具调用返回一个函数列表，其中的单个条目包含名称、描述和 Python 实现，并且为没有实际工作的跨度保留一个空列表。. The tool call returns a functions list whose single entry holds a name, a description, and a Python implementation, and an empty list is reserved for spans with no real work.

附录BAppendix B技能记忆机制Skill Memory Mechanics

两个存储器都嵌入了技能描述和查询Both memories embed skill descriptions and queries with全MiniLM-L6-v2all-MiniLM-L6-v2并通过余弦相似度对候选者进行排名。检索返回高于 0.30 的前 5 个文本或代码技能。选定的代码技能还会提取它调用的存储函数。新的文本技能合并到描述相似度超过0.85的存储条目中，替换过程行并仅附加未见过的项目符号，否则成为新条目。新的代码技能会覆盖其重用的函数名称的条目，在描述相似度为 0.85 时作为接近重复的条目被丢弃，否则将成为新条目。执行反馈进一步修剪代码技能。无法加载到执行命名空间的存储函数将被删除。 每个删除都会级联到其源调用被删除函数的函数。and rank candidates by cosine similarity. Retrieval returns the top 5 text or code skills above 0.30. A selected code skill also pulls in the stored functions it calls. A new text skill merges into a stored entry whose description similarity exceeds 0.85, replacing the procedure line and appending only unseen bullets, and otherwise becomes a new entry. A new code skill overwrites the entry whose function name it reuses, is dropped as a near duplicate at description similarity 0.85, and otherwise becomes a new entry. Execution feedback prunes code skills further. A stored function that fails to load into the execution namespace is removed. Each removal cascades to the functions whose source calls the removed one.

附录CAppendix C诱导技能的例子Examples of Induced Skills

我们展示了 Qwen3-235B-A22B 在一项 AppWorld 任务中诱导的真实技能，该任务要求代理订购亚马逊购物车中的所有举重凳。每个技能在其源轨迹之后、在任何后续合并之前都显示为诱导的。任务级归纳产生了整个任务的一项技能（图 1 和 2）。We show real skills induced by Qwen3-235B-A22B from one AppWorld task, which asks the agent to order all weightlifting benches in the Amazon cart. Each skill appears as induced right after its source trajectory, before any later merge. Task-level induction yields one skill for the whole task (Figs.21和and22），并且子任务级归纳为每个子任务产生一项技能，本次运行为三项（图 1-2）。), and subtask-level induction yields one skill per subtask, three in this run (Figs.23和and24）。范围对比最容易在代码格式中看到，因为任务级函数将源任务的产品关键字保留为其默认参数，而子任务级函数在登录、购物车过滤和下订单方面保持通用。). The scope contrast is easiest to see in the code format, as the task-level function keeps the source task’s product keyword as its default argument while the subtask-level functions stay generic over login, cart filtering, and order placement.

附录DAppendix D评估指标Evaluation Metrics

D.1 表现评分Performance Scoring

每个基准测试的官方评估员将已完成的任务映射到以下分数：Each benchmark’s official evaluator maps a finished task to a score in[0,1][0,1]，报告的某个条件的任务成功率是其任务的平均分数。 （, and the reported task success of a condition is the mean score over its tasks. (i）AppWorld 通过其官方的基于状态的单元测试对任务进行评分，该测试检查代理 API 调用留下的最终环境状态。当每个测试都通过时，分数为 1，否则分数为 0。 （) AppWorld scores a task with its official state-based unit tests, which check the final environment state left by the agent’s API calls. The score is 1 when every test passes and 0 otherwise. (ii) OfficeBench 为每个任务附加官方检查器功能，检查代理留在沙箱中的文件和应用程序状态。当每个检查者都通过时得分为 1，否则得分为 0。 （) OfficeBench attaches official checker functions to each task, which inspect the files and application state the agent leaves in the sandbox. The score is 1 when every checker passes and 0 otherwise. (三、iii) KramaBench 使用其答案类型的官方确定性评分器以及从不提交分数 0 的任务，根据黄金答案对提交的答案进行评分。在较小的数字容差下，精确的数字和字符串答案分数为 0 或 1。列表答案得分与黄金列表的 F1 重叠，以及近似数字答案得分) KramaBench grades the submitted answer against the gold answer with the official deterministic scorer of its answer type, and a task that never submits scores 0. Exact numeric and string answers score 0 or 1 under a small numeric tolerance. List answers score the F1 overlap with the gold list, and approximate numeric answers score1/(1+e)1/(1+e)对于相对绝对误差for a relative absolute erroree。因此，每个任务的分数是连续的，由法学硕士法官评分的少数任务被排除在我们的任务集中。. The per-task score is therefore continuous, and the few tasks graded by an LLM judge are excluded from our task set.

任务的延迟是其挂钟时间。依赖性是 MEM1 成本The latency of a task is its wall-clock time. dependency=∑c(2​pc+oc)​oc2,\mathrm{dependency}=\sum_{c}\frac{(2p_{c}+o_{c})\,o_{c}}{2},

E.2 具有子任务技能的任务级代理Task-Level Agent with Subtask Skills

我们验证了两个诱导水平之间的差距来自诱导技能，而不是来自使用它们的代理。我们在检索时将子任务级代理诱导的技能记忆重播到任务级代理中，因此任务级代理使用子任务级代理当时拥有的相同库输入每个任务，并且我们冻结归纳，以便该库保留子任务级代理自己的库。We verify that the gap between the two induction levels comes from the induced skills rather than from the agent that uses them. We replay the skill memory induced by the subtask-level agent into the task-level agent at retrieval time, so the task-level agent enters each task with the same library the subtask-level agent had at that point, and we freeze induction so the library stays the subtask-level agent’s own.

图。Fig.25将检索子任务技能的任务级代理与检索其原始任务级技能的同一代理进行比较，在 Qwen3-235B-A22B 和 GPT-OSS-120B 上对两种技能格式进行平均。子任务级技能在每个基准上都击败了原始技能compares the task-level agent retrieving subtask skills against the same agent retrieving its original task-level skills, averaged over the two skill formats, on Qwen3-235B-A22B and GPT-OSS-120B. E.5 重用频率和技能格式Reuse Frequency and Skill Format

图。Fig.6故意合并两种技能格式，因为重用频率跟踪归纳级别效果而不是格式效果。代码技能与文本技能一样频繁地被检索，或者更常见的是，在六个基准和格式组合中的五个上检索，但它们带来的收益较小（第二节）。pools the two skill formats on purpose, because reuse frequency tracks the induction-level effect but not the format effect. Code skills are retrieved as often as Text skills, or more often, on five of the six benchmark and format combinations, yet they bring smaller gains (Sec.5.2）。重用频率衡量一项技能被检索的频率，而不是它的应用范围，因此它区分了两个归纳级别，但没有区分两种格式。因此，我们使用技能效用分数对技能记忆进行排名，该分数读取抽象性的格式效果，而不是原始重用计数。). Reuse frequency measures how often a skill is retrieved, not how broadly it applies, so it separates the two induction levels but not the two formats. We therefore rank skill memories with the skill utility score, which reads the format effect off abstractness, rather than with raw reuse counts.

E.6 检索质量的验证Validation of Retrieval Quality

我们检查猎犬以验证技能效果并非源于猎犬的质量。我们假设从一项任务中获得的技能应该可以从同一任务中检索出来。具体来说，我们计算每种技能与衍生该技能的任务或子任务之间的余弦相似度。一项技能算作We inspect the retriever to validate that the skill effect does not stem from retriever quality. We hypothesize that a skill induced from a task should be retrievable from that same task. Specifically, we compute the cosine similarity between each skill and the task or subtask from which it was induced. A skill counts as可自行检索self-retrievable如果该相似度超过该任务或子任务与其最初检索到的技能之间的最小相似度。换句话说，该技能将在其来源的原始检索集中排名。所有条件都使用已部署的嵌入器和相同的检索阈值，因此两种格式和两种归纳级别都面临相同的栏。if this similarity exceeds the minimum similarity between that task or subtask and its originally retrieved skills. In other words, the skill would rank inside the original retrieval set of its source. All conditions use the deployed embedder and the same retrieval thresholds, so both formats and both induction levels face the same bar.
